nodes.name: 柳瓢
who: the grey-haired witch of the wagons
nodes.light: almost no light: the faint cold blue of the night sky over black glassy mountains, the pale glint of water in a ladle, and the dim molten-gold glow of one woman's eyes
nodes.camera: low on the camp road just behind the drinking traveller, looking up at the seated woman at the camp mouth; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a spring night in a great camp on a black plain, the one night of the year when no lamp is lit. The camp has no wall; behind its mouth lie the dark shapes of thousands of low houses of burnt white stone roofed with black obsidian flakes, not one window lit. Around the whole basin a ring of mountains rises against the sky, their inner faces turned to black glass that catches a faint cold sheen. At the mouth of the camp stands a plain upright stone carved with rows of marks. Beside it, facing us, the grey-haired witch of the wagons sits on a low block of stone: a slender woman who looks about twenty-five, long straight ash-silver hair worn loose and darker grey toward the tips, cold pale skin, a tiny ruby-red mark at one temple, and gold eyes that glow faintly in the dark like freshly molten copper. She wears a long deep grey coat with mountain-copper buttons, its hem dusty, over a plain dark dress; a black glove reaches to her right elbow, a short black glove covers her left hand. Her right hand rests on the rim of a wooden water bucket at her feet; her left hand holds out a ladle of willow wood brimming with water, its handle cut round with twenty-one small notches. In the near foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, a hooded traveller who has just walked in out of the dark is seen directly from behind, bending forward to drink from the ladle she holds. Beside the stone stands the old gatekeeper of the camp, wrapped in a shawl, empty-handed. Far behind on the road, small and dim, more hooded travellers come toward the camp mouth one by one. Her face is calm and patient. Dust and a few drifting grass seeds float large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕选灰雨之夜那一夜，她坐在营口替守门人给进营的人递水，源稿第127行。守门人和夜里进营的人源稿没写样子，只写了一句。全名、刻正面那几拍留给收束那一幅的碑。

nodes.name: 泥板
who: the smoke-haired woman with chalk-white fingertips
nodes.light: warm spring daylight from the left, the great copper slab throwing a long dark red-gold shadow across the row of clay tablets
nodes.camera: very low, at the level of the wet clay tablets, looking across them at the kneeling woman, the queue behind her; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a spring day at the centre of a great camp on a black plain, the day the first law stele was raised. At the right edge of the picture, cut off by the frame, rises the foot of an enormous slab of dark red-gold mountain copper, taller than three men and more than ten paces wide; on its back the top rows are freshly cut with carved marks that still shine. Along its foot runs a long row of wet clay tablets laid on the ground, each the size of a roof tile, many already pressed with handprints. At the nearest tablet, facing us, kneels the smoke-haired woman with chalk-white fingertips: tall and thin, about thirty to look at, smoke-violet hair cropped very short, dark violet eyes, slightly pointed ears, a faint pale ring around her left wrist where a lock sat for seventy-two years. She wears a grey wool camp coat patched over and over, an empty little knife sheath at her belt. Her own small knife lies set aside on the edge of the tablet. Her right hand is pressed flat and bare into the wet clay, and that whole hand has turned white, the whiteness running past the knuckles to the wrist, without a drop of blood. Her left hand rests on her knee. Her face is still and cool, her eyes lowered to the white hand in the clay. Behind her waits a long queue of demon-kin men and women of the old blood-giving families, horned and pale, in plain coats; most still hold a small knife in one hand and turn the other palm up; the first few, looking at her white hand, are sliding their knives back into their sheaths. Far behind them the crowd stretches back to the camp mouth. Dust and flecks of dried clay drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕选茹丝把刀搁下、按了一只发白的手、后头的人把刀收回鞘里，源稿第138行，题下那一句就是她这一拍。七个人在碑前跪下那一拍没有画，见 notes。

nodes.name: 炉箍
who: the horned smith-general with a broken horn
nodes.light: roaring orange-white light from the open furnace on the right against the deep blue of a spring night, a faint pale glow of wings far above the roofs
nodes.camera: low beside the furnace, close on the clamping hands, the line of people and the far obelisk beyond; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a spring night in a carvers' yard at the edge of a great camp on a black plain. A squat stone furnace fills the right half of the picture, its mouth wide open and roaring, its top cut off by the frame. The camp has just tipped into it a whole chest of ancient temple offerings, bowls, cups and dishes of gold, copper and dark mountain copper; their old ritual patterns glow dull red as they slump, and the molten metal heaves up against the furnace walls as if to burst them. In the middle of the picture, in full profile facing right, stands the horned smith-general with a broken horn: very tall and heavy-boned, deep ash-grey skin, black-brown hair cropped short, red eyes; his left horn glossy black, his right horn broken off above a ring of obsidian, twenty notches cut into the stump and glowing red. He wears dark self-forged plate whose seams glow like cooling lava. With his bare hands he has just bent a bar of red-hot iron into a hoop around the furnace mouth and is clamping it shut: his left hand presses the hoop down on the near side, his right hand squeezes its two ends together, and the iron has gone white-hot where his fingers close. Behind him on the left, people of the camp, demon-kin and tieflings in plain work clothes, stand in a line holding more chests of offerings. Near the furnace, beside three carts piled with broken stone slabs, a thin pale man of the bone folk in a charcoal robe crouches, touching the fragments one by one with the back of his hand. Far away above the low black-roofed houses, a tall black obsidian obelisk is rising upright on chains, and around its tip winged figures beat their wings, one of them spreading four extra wings of glassy pale light. Sparks and flakes of glowing metal fly large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕选瓦尔德拉克把烧软的铁条攥成炉箍扣住炉口，源稿第144行。莫尔图斯碰碎块（第146行）、格罗姆和夜翼立方尖塔（第148行）是同一夜，放在远处，没进 who。

nodes.name: 雪中碑背
nodes.light: the flat white light of a snowy winter afternoon, a little warmth glinting in the dark red-gold copper
nodes.camera: low and close beside the foot of the slab, looking along its carved back toward the two women; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a winter afternoon in a city of black-roofed houses on a black plain; snow is falling softly. The back of an enormous slab of dark red-gold mountain copper rises along the right side of the picture and is cut off by the top of the frame: from top to bottom it is covered with row after row of small carved marks, and the cuts still glint where the snow has not settled. A wooden scaffold leans against it, dusted white. At its foot, in full profile facing right toward the copper, stands the pink-braided stone-carver: a sturdy, broad-shouldered young woman with cherry-blossom pink hair in one thick braid coiled at the back of her head and pinned with an old worn chisel, a thin chisel tucked behind her ear, teal-green eyes, a fine dust of black stone powder on her face and brows, a crookedly knitted grey scarf at her neck, grey canvas work clothes patched with leather at the knees, a belt of nine chisels. Her right hand holds up the elbow of a very old tiefling woman beside her, and her left hand steadies the old woman's wrist. The old woman, also in full profile, is small and bent, about a hundred years old, her short hair gone white with only a trace of misty blue, small stone-grey horns with tips ground round, a crooked little stone tag at her neck; her trembling bare fingertips are touching the very last carved row at the bottom of the slab. Her face is calm. Behind them, on the snowy ground, twelve thousand dried clay tablets are stacked in long low rows, and beyond the slab stands a tall black obelisk. Snowflakes drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束选865年寒星月背面刻满，叶琳叫人扶着去摸最后一行，源稿第153行、第3754行。扶她的是斯塔娜是我补的，源稿只写叫人扶着。叶琳的立绘是790年二十五岁的，没进 who，照百岁的老人写。

nodes.name: 满弦
who: the blue-haired archer on the wall
nodes.light: the first sun rising behind the wall at our back, the long blue shadow of the wall thrown down the slope, the far slope in pale gold
nodes.camera: low on the wall-walk directly behind the archer, looking past his shoulder and down the long slope; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn in early spring on a high white stone wall that runs away to the horizon on both sides. We stand on the wall-walk directly behind a young archer and look out over the crenel in front of him. Below, a long slope of burnt and regrown grass falls away westward; across it runs the bed of an old dry river, and in the riverbed stands the stump of an ancient stone bridge pier, upright and alone. Up the slope from the bottom climbs a line of wooden stakes tied with strips of white cloth, crossing the dry riverbed and stopping some two hundred paces from the foot of the wall. Behind the last stake stand a few dozen small figures with coils of rope and mallets, humans, horned demon-kin and short-horned tieflings, and among them a tall woman with dark grey wings folded tight down her back; above her two winged figures circle in the air. In the near foreground, seen directly from behind, the blue-haired archer on the wall: tall, lean and broad-shouldered, short lake-blue hair with one stubborn tuft sticking up at the back, a grey soldier's coat over a padded leather jerkin, a quiver at his hip. His left arm is stretched straight out toward the slope, the left hand gripping a tall longbow whose limbs glow with faint spell-lines; his right hand has drawn the string all the way back to his right cheek, the nocked arrow aimed low, at the ground a single step in front of the winged woman's feet. A little further along the wall-walk to the left, the garrison commander stands at a crenel and watches. The long shadow of the wall lies across the slope. Dawn dust and a few loose grass seeds drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕选泽普拉满了弓、箭对着她脚前一步的那一下，源稿第446到447行。伊芮丝在坡上是远处的小人，没进 who。

nodes.name: 铆眼
who: the mint-haired carver of the east
the grey-skinned tiefling carver of the west
nodes.light: low warm late-autumn sun from the right, the white stone glowing faintly on its own, a sudden bolt of white light through the seam
nodes.camera: low and close, looking south straight along the seam between the two stones so that it runs down the middle of the picture; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late-autumn afternoon on a slope of grass one arrow-shot west of a high white wall. In the middle of the picture stand two blocks of stone set back to back, each waist-high: the left one white stone like the wall, glowing faintly even by day, the right one black obsidian, glossy and warm. The narrow seam where they meet runs straight down the centre of the picture; it is the line between two countries. Near their top edge, rivet holes are being cut from both sides to pin the two stones together. On the left, in full profile facing right, the mint-haired carver of the east: short and stocky, mint-green hair in one braid coiled at the back of her head under a tied cloth, honey-coloured eyes narrowed with two deep lines at their corners, fine white scars across the backs of her hands, a heavy leather apron over a canvas coat. Her left hand sets a chisel to her rivet hole in the white stone; her right hand has just struck it with a chasing hammer. From the chisel point a bolt of white light has shot along an old vein in the white stone, straight across the seam and into the black stone. On the right, in full profile facing left, the grey-skinned tiefling carver of the west: thin and a little stooped, pale grey skin with faint dark markings on his hands, short glossy black horns sweeping back from the temples with hemp cord wound at their roots, curly dark teal hair, orange-red eyes, a thin tail with a split tip hooked round one ankle, a leather apron over black work clothes. His right hand tilts a slant-ground chisel sideways to follow the line of light into the obsidian; his left hand holds a stone mallet raised. A single arrow stands upright in the ground a step from the stones. On the left, behind the carver of the east, the white wall rises with a small wall-town on it and runs away into the distance. Stone dust and glittering obsidian chips drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕选两边一起打铆眼、碧吉特的凿子碰到旧纹、白光冲进黑石、伦佐斜过右腕跟着走，源稿第461行。那支箭十日夜里才拔，这时候还立在石头边上。

nodes.name: 种袋
nodes.light: cold clear late-autumn morning sun from behind the wall, the wall's long blue shadow over the nearest ground, the field beyond in pale gold
nodes.camera: low at the level of the soil beside the furrow, the kneeling soldier large in the foreground; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a clear late-autumn morning in a freshly ploughed field at the foot of a high white stone wall. The wall rises along the whole left side of the picture and is cut off by the top of the frame; its long blue shadow lies across the nearest ground. The furrows run straight away from the wall toward the right, dark and newly turned, and at the far end of the field, one arrow-shot away, stands a waist-high boundary stone, its white face turned toward the wall. Here and there in the field the plough has curved around a few old grave mounds marked with weathered stones. Further off, several soldiers in grey coats walk the furrows sowing grain from sacks at their hips. In the near foreground, kneeling at the head of a furrow right below the wall, at the very edge of the shadow, is the blue-haired soldier-farmer in full profile facing right: tall and lean, short lake-blue hair with one stubborn tuft at the back, sky-blue eyes, cheeks reddened by the wind, a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, patched grey trousers, no blade anywhere on him. His left hand holds open a small worn cloth pouch, the kind a mother sews; his right hand lets a thin stream of wheat grains fall from his fingers into the furrow, carefully, a few at a time. His head is bowed, his face gentle and absorbed. Far beyond the boundary stone, small, a tall woman with dark grey wings folded tight stands and watches. A few grains and specks of soil hang large and out of focus across the near corners, lit by the sun.
nodes.note: 三幕选中旬九日泽普在离墙最近的那一垄撒下他母亲那一把种，源稿第475行。伊芮丝那一天在不在碑西边源稿没写，放成远处的小人。

nodes.name: 千碑夜
nodes.light: winter night: the cold white glow of the wall and of the white stone faces, small warm lamps on stone tops, snow reflecting both
nodes.camera: low, a few steps south of the first boundary stone, looking north along the line of stones beside the wall; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a winter night at the foot of a high white wall that glows faintly by itself; snow lies over the fields. The wall runs along the right side of the picture and away into the distance. One arrow-shot out from it, a line of waist-high boundary stones runs away from us beside the wall as far as the eye can see, thousands of them; the face of each that looks toward the wall is white and glows softly like the wall itself, so that a long chain of small white lights stretches into the dark, and on the tops of some of them small lamps are burning. In the foreground stands the first of these stones, its white face glowing toward the wall on the right, its black face toward the dark fields on the left. Beside it, on its right, in full profile facing left, stands the blue-haired soldier-farmer: now in his mid-forties, lean and broad-shouldered, short lake-blue hair with a stubborn tuft at the back and a little grey at the temples, fine lines at his sky-blue eyes, his cheeks red with cold, a grey soldier's coat with frayed cuffs. With his right hand he is setting a round loaf of bread on the top of the stone; his left hand holds a small horn lantern low at his side. His face is quiet and sad. A few paces to the left of the stone, on its dark western side, a small new gravestone stands in the snow over a low mound of earth. Further off, the wheat field sleeps under the snow. Snowflakes drift large and out of focus across the near corners, lit white and gold.
nodes.note: 收束选889年寒星月伊芮丝死的那天夜里泽普在碑顶放面包，和到889年墙下几千块碑一齐亮，源稿第489到490行。泽普那时四十五岁，立绘是二十五岁的，往四十多岁写了，鬓角的灰是我补的。

nodes.name: 锅沿
nodes.light: warm orange firelight from under a huge cauldron, steam glowing gold, the cold blue of an autumn night outside the shed
nodes.camera: low, at the height of the cooking fire, the tilted cauldron large in the middle; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an autumn night under a soup-kitchen shed in the poor lower streets of a great river city; beyond the open shed lie dark warehouses and the masts of a dock. A huge iron cauldron of soup sits over a fire on an iron stand, and one leg of the stand has just burnt through: the cauldron has lurched to one side and is about to pour its boiling soup into the fire. On the right, in full profile facing left, the red-braided fish-gutter has caught it: a tall, sturdy, broad-shouldered woman of nearly forty, fiery red hair in a thick braid coiled at the back of her head under a faded blue-grey kerchief, amber eyes, a long oilcloth apron over a dark brown wool dress with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a worn tin tag on a leather cord at her neck. Her bare right hand is clamped on the rim of the cauldron, holding its whole tilted weight level; her left hand is braced flat on her bent knee. Thick steam wraps both her arms and glows gold, and her rough red hands stay unburnt. Her jaw is set and she is half laughing. A boy is shoving a flat new stone in under the broken leg. On the left, facing us, a thin woman in her early thirties has just stood up from the bench where she has sat for three nights: a plain dusty brown travelling dress, a grey shawl, her hair under a plain linen cap, an old iron tin box tucked under her left arm; with her right hand she lifts the long soup ladle out of the pot and holds it clear. Behind them a queue of hungry people with wooden bowls watches. Steam and sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕选下街粥棚第三夜锅架烧断一脚、安格拉扣住锅沿、海尔加站起来托住勺子，源稿第777行。海尔加没有立绘，照人物条写成三十出头的磨坊家寡妇，半张令装在胳膊底下那只铁皮匣子里。垫石头的孩子是我补的。

nodes.name: 黑玻璃
who: the shaven-headed little girl in grey
nodes.light: dim and dusky inside the small room; outside, the cool grey daylight of a high stone hall seen darkened through black glass
nodes.camera: inside the small dark room, low, just behind the little girl, looking out through the pane of black glass; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a spring day in a great court of black stone on a terrace above a city. We are inside a small dim room beside the court's main hall. One wall of the room is a single large pane of black volcanic glass; from inside you can see through it as through smoked glass, while from the hall outside only a shadow can be made out. In the near foreground, seen directly from behind, stands the shaven-headed little girl in grey: a small nine-year-old wrapped in a grey coat much too big for her, her head shaved, a little wheat-blond stubble at the nape, small shoes. She has raised her left hand and pressed her small palm flat against the black glass at the height of her face; her right hand hangs at her side holding the edge of the big coat. On the other side of the glass, dim and darkened, facing us, her mother has pressed her own right palm against the very same spot: a thin village woman in her early thirties in a plain brown dress and grey shawl, her hair under a linen cap, leaning so close that her face almost touches the glass; her eyes are wet and she is smiling. Her left hand holds an old iron tin box to her chest. Behind her stretches the great hall: a floor of black stone polished like a mirror, reflecting her figure upside down, long wooden benches in rows, tall windows of grey light. Far back by the benches stands a grave man in a dark coat, watching and not coming closer. Dust motes drift large and out of focus in the dim air of the small room.
nodes.note: 二幕选清露月上旬七日海尔加把手按在黑玻璃上、里头一只小手按在同一个地方，源稿第796行。莉妮九岁，只画隔着玻璃的这一下，用了立绘目录里有的 s6b_linnie，她背对镜头。远处那个人是拉尔斯。

nodes.name: 地上之影
nodes.light: slanting late-afternoon light from tall windows across a black mirror-polished floor, everything else in cool shadow
nodes.camera: almost at floor level, so that the black floor and its reflections fill the lower half of the picture; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: late afternoon in the great hall of a court built of black stone. The floor is a single sheet of black stone polished like a mirror, and everyone who stands on it is doubled by a dark reflection beneath their feet. In the background, on the middle one of three long wooden benches, sit three judges: a grave dark-coated advocate of middle years, a young advocate and a soldier in a plain coat; at a small table beside them sits a priestess in white with a palm-sized grey-white stone seal before her, cut with seven fine lines. Behind, rows of onlookers on benches lean forward. On the left of the picture, in full profile facing right, stands the tall shaven-headed Stone-Keeper: a thin man in his sixties, a little bent, a shaved head with faint old scars, a long face, deep-set dark green eyes, a grey robe washed almost white with the cuffs buttoned tight, a white stone with a faint rose-red spot pinned at his collar. In both hands he holds a big old ledger open against his chest; his forefinger has stopped on one line. On the right, in full profile facing left toward the judges, the old white-haired judge has just risen from her bench: a small, thin, stooped woman of over seventy, very short white hair under a black cloth cap, pale violet eyes wide open, a judge's black robe with wide sleeves and a white inner band. Her left hand hangs at her side clenched tight around a small white stone, the knuckles white; her right hand rests on the back of the bench she has just left. Her face is very still. Under both of them, their reflections stand upside down in the black floor. Dust motes drift large and out of focus in the slanting light across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕选克里斯托夫念到罗泽·施莱伯那一行停住、阿玛莉亚从认账的长凳上站起来说她认得，源稿第812行。阿玛莉亚这时已经是审判长，衣服挑了正装那一套。

nodes.name: 坡上白石
nodes.light: warm, clear light of a summer afternoon in the mountains, from the left
nodes.camera: low among the small grave stones on the slope, close beside the kneeling man; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a summer afternoon in the eastern mountains, on the grassy slope behind an old grey stone cloister. The cloister's grey walls stand at the top of the picture, and its gate stands wide open. The whole slope below the walls is covered with rows and rows of small plain stones half sunk in the grass, hundreds of them, each the size of a loaf. In the foreground, kneeling in full profile facing right before one of these little stones, is the tall shaven-headed Stone-Keeper: a thin man in his sixties, a shaved head with a few faint old scars, a long face, deep-set dark green eyes, a plain grey coat with nothing pinned at the collar, the cuffs still buttoned tight over his wrists. With his right hand he is setting a small white stone with a faint rose-red spot on top of the little grave stone; his left hand rests flat on the grass beside it, where he has just pulled a few weeds. His face is quiet and sorrowful, and his lips move as if he were humming. Far down the slope, a mountain path winds away into the valley, and along it a few small figures walk away in a line: children in grey with their families, and a pair of priests in white with lanterns leading a few more. Near the open gate, a handful of grown men and women in grey stand and watch the path. Summer grass seeds and a few white petals drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束选炎潮月院门开了、克里斯托夫把领口的白石放在院后坡上罗泽的坟头，源稿第822行和第4192行。下山的孩子和留下的十一个大人放在远处，开院门和放白石是不是同一天源稿没写死。

nodes.name: 洞口点数
who: the towering troll woman with a rust-red braid
the night-wing lamp-keeper with a burnt wing
nodes.light: the last dull orange of a winter dusk low behind us, the tunnel mouth pitch black, warm copper lamplight on the left, cold blue on the black ridge
nodes.camera: low, a few steps outside the tunnel mouth, looking straight into it along the two stone rails; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: winter dusk at the foot of a black ridge, at the west mouth of a tunnel. The arched mouth fills the middle of the picture, pitch black inside; two rails of dark blue-black stone blocks, each grooved with two channels for wheels, run out of it toward us. Beside the rails stand a stone well, a small stone house, a coal heap and a tall copper plate on a post, still bare. Out of the black mouth, walking toward us one behind another, comes a long file of convicts in rough clothes, dusty from a day of laying stone; each has a short chain at one ankle with a closed lock and a small copper tag. Near the front walks the barefoot fire-horn rail-layer, facing us: tall and lean, deep ochre skin, two horns sweeping back with tips black as burnt flint, close-cropped dark brick-red hair, ember-orange eyes, a coarse short tunic and a leather apron, his boots tied together and slung over one shoulder, a closed lock and copper tag at his left ankle. On the left, in full profile facing right, stands the night-wing lamp-keeper with a burnt wing: tall and thin, grey-brown hair tied at the nape, large ink-blue eyes, a dark grey robe; his right wing is folded neatly but the outer half of his left wing is burnt into charred holes and drags behind him. His right hand holds up an old cracked copper lamp to the face of each man who passes; in its circle of light a faint second face is peeling away from one worker's shoulder like mist. On the right, in full profile facing left, the towering troll woman with a rust-red braid: huge, rough grey-teal hide, a short dark horn stub on each side of the forehead, a rust-red braid wound round her neck, a white scar on her chin, a canvas apron; her right hand swings a short bar of black hardwood down onto the rail, her left hand is raised, counting. Far off on the right, an old troll woman sits on a boulder, and on the ridge top a small stone tower shows one lamp. Coal dust and fine stone grit drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕选天黑收工三百个犯人出洞、利诺斯举灯照脸、蕾娃敲轨数人，源稿第1052、1064、1065行。曼苏尔这时锁还没开，立绘那一套脚上是开了的锁，text 里写成锁着。坐在石头上的是特鲁达。

nodes.name: 断钩
who: the towering troll woman with a rust-red braid
nodes.light: torchlight from a ring of torches on the walls, the red glow of the departing engine's firebox to the left, cold steel-blue on the black iron links
nodes.camera: at rail level, almost on the stone floor beside the old groove, looking up at the snapping coupling and the last car; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night, deep under a black ridge, in a vast round hall carved out of a single mass of black stone. Its ceiling is lost above the reach of the torches stuck along the walls, and the curved walls are cut with ring above ring of carved number marks, without a single name. Around the hall gape nine dark openings, boarded over with planks. Through the middle runs a new rail of grooved blue-black stone, and right beside it, wider and polished smooth, an ancient groove in the floor. A short train has just started: to the left, its engine and fourteen wagons heaped with ore and coal are pulling away into the dark, trailing black smoke and the red glow of the firebox. Its last car, an open flatcar crowded with forty-one people, has been left behind. Up out of the old groove beside the rail has reared a long string of black iron links, each hooked to the next; its foremost link has hooked the flatcar's coupling, and at this instant the coupling snaps apart like a dry stick, splinters of iron flying. On the flatcar, standing on its edge in full profile facing left toward the vanishing train, is the towering troll woman with a rust-red braid: huge, rough grey-teal hide, short horn stubs, a rust-red braid wound round her neck, a leather jerkin under a canvas apron; both hands grip a black hardwood bar across her body. Seated behind her, facing us, the barefoot fire-horn rail-layer has thrown out his right arm to brace himself on the car's side, an opened lock still hanging at his left ankle. Around them on the car, freed convicts and young workers stare down at the groove. Iron splinters and sparks fly large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕选老槽里翻上来的黑链扣住车钩、车钩断的那一下，源稿第1076行。车上四十一个人里雾钎家的弟弟十七岁，这一下没有人受伤。

nodes.name: 旧站
who: the night-wing lamp-keeper with a burnt wing
nodes.light: one warm circle of copper lamplight in the middle, cold blue-white light from a row of stone lamps far behind, black everywhere else
nodes.camera: low beside the platform edge, the lamp-keeper large on the right, the line of people passing under his lamp toward the left; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep night far inside a tunnel under a black ridge, at an abandoned underground station whose walls are covered with carved number marks. A narrow stone platform runs along the left of the picture beside an old polished groove in the floor. On the right, on the platform's edge, stands the night-wing lamp-keeper with a burnt wing, in full profile facing left: tall and thin, grey-brown hair tied at the nape, large ink-blue eyes, a grey robe belted tight; his right wing folded, the outer half of his left wing burnt into charred holes and trailing on the stone. His right hand holds an old cracked copper lamp up at shoulder height; his left hand hangs open at his side, two of its fingers bent. The stone of the floor has risen around his feet, soft as wet clay, and closed over his boots up to the ankles. In the warm circle of his lamp, people can see one another for the first time: a long line of men and women walks past him from right to left, each with one hand on the shoulder of the one ahead, some carried on others' backs. At the front, facing us as he comes toward the left edge, walks the barefoot fire-horn rail-layer: deep ochre skin, horns with black tips, close-cropped brick-red hair, ember-orange eyes, a coarse tunic, an opened lock hanging at his left ankle; his bare feet feel their way along the groove. Behind him walks a huge troll woman, barefoot, blood running from the torn soles of her feet. Far back beyond the lamplight, a long stone altar stands in the dark with a row of stone lamps burning cold and blue-white, and under them crowds of motionless figures stand and do not turn. Dust drifts large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕选利诺斯在旧站举灯站住、石头合到靴面、队从他灯底下过去，源稿第1089到1091行。参考图 bronze_011_3 上是黑链缠脚踝，源稿写的是地合上来，text 照源稿写。蕾娃脚底撕破流血，写了 raw。

nodes.name: 十四道
who: the towering troll woman with a rust-red braid
nodes.light: cold pale gold of a spring dawn, long shadows, the copper plate catching the light
nodes.camera: low beside the copper plate, close on the troll woman's hand and the carved strokes; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn in early spring at a small station at the foot of a black ridge: a stone well with a wooden water bucket on a pump arm, a little stone house, a coal heap. A tall copper plate stands on a post by the well and fills the right of the picture, cut off by the frame; on it, under one carved row of marks, fourteen short upright strokes have just been cut in a row, and where a fifteenth would be there are three short lines of carved marks instead. In front of it, in full profile facing right, stands the towering troll woman with a rust-red braid: a head taller than a door frame, broad and powerful, rough grey-teal hide, a short dark horn stub on each side of the forehead, coarse rust-red hair in one braid wound around her neck, a white scar on her chin, a thick canvas apron over a sleeveless shirt, her arms bare. Her right hand holds a short carving knife against the plate, finishing the last mark; her left hand rests flat on the copper above it. Her bare feet are wrapped in strips of cloth, pink new skin showing at the edges. Her face, usually loud and cheerful, is set and quiet. Behind her rises the black ridge with the dark tunnel mouth; on a bench by the stone house sit a barefoot fire-horn man and a night-wing with a burnt left wing, the night-wing holding an old copper lamp, unlit, in his lap. Far off along the stone rails, a train of fourteen wagons pulls away westward under a plume of black smoke. Coal dust and dawn mist drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束选上旬四日天亮蕾娃在山铜板上画了十四道、刻了三个名字，源稿第1096行。曼苏尔和利诺斯坐在站屋边是我补的，他们天亮以前出了洞。巴尔缇娜在半路数十四、按地那几拍没有画。

nodes.name: 隔碑
nodes.light: bright golden early-autumn noon, high sun, warm shadows under the wheat
nodes.camera: low in the stubble south of the boundary stone, looking north straight along the line, the stone in the middle; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: noon at harvest time in a field of ripe wheat at the foot of a long white stone wall. The wheat on both sides has grown into one golden sea, half of it already cut into sheaves; two rows of reapers, one from each side, have cut their way up to the same waist-high boundary stone and stopped there. The stone stands in the middle of the picture: its right half white like the wall, its left half black obsidian, pinned together with mountain copper. On the right of the stone, the wall side, sits the ash-blonde fire warden in full profile facing left: a tall, slim nineteen-year-old soldier, ash-blonde hair cut level with her chin with the ends a little singed, emerald eyes with smoke-reddened rims, freckles across her cheeks, a grey wool coat and a scorched leather apron, a wooden tag tied on her right wrist. Her right hand holds a heel of bread; her left hand rests on a wooden fire-bell pole propped against the white face. On the left of the stone sits the tall black-haired contract farmer in full profile facing right: long-boned and broad-shouldered, stiff short black hair with a blue sheen, deep blue eyes, a coarse undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, his hands still whole and unscarred, a cloth seed bag across his chest; his left hand holds a water flask, his right is lifted a little as he calls something to her, grinning. Neither has moved one step past the stone. At its black foot sits a bent old man with white stubble, sharpening a sickle on a whetstone. Far behind on the right, swallows dart around the arrow slits of a small wall-town on the white wall; behind on the left, beyond the stone, stand a row of thatched grain sheds and a threshing yard. Wheat chaff and dust drift large and out of focus across the near corners, gilded by the sun.
nodes.note: 一幕选上旬五日中午两边隔着碑吃饭、斯坦科在碑西脚磨镰刀，源稿第1340行。博扬的立绘是火以后的样子，手上有疤，text 里写明这时手还是好的。燕子是照燕巢段城的来历添的。

nodes.name: 马灯
nodes.light: the orange glare of burning wheat all round, two small warm lanterns on the stone, the cold white glow of the distant wall
nodes.camera: low on the burnt black ground west of the boundary stone, looking east at its black face; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an early-autumn night lit by fire, at a boundary stone in the middle of a burning wheat field below a long white wall. All around, the wheat burns in long orange walls driven by the wind; only the ground around the stone has already burnt black and is safe. The waist-high stone stands in the middle of the picture with its black obsidian face toward us, and two horn-shaded lanterns now sit on its top, one at each end. Behind the stone, on its far side and facing us over its top, stands the ash-blonde fire warden: a slim nineteen-year-old soldier, ash-blonde hair cut at the chin with singed ends, emerald eyes red from smoke, freckles under soot, a grey coat buttoned up, a scorched leather apron, gloves; her right hand has just let go of the lantern she set on the stone, her left hand grips a wooden fire-bell pole. Her face is streaked with soot and tears and perfectly still. On the near side, at the right, in full profile facing left toward the stone, stands the tall black-haired contract farmer: long-boned, stiff black hair, deep blue eyes, a sooty linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a seed bag across his chest. His left hand has just set the second lantern on the stone, and that left forearm has just been shot through, blood running from the wound down to his fingers; both his palms are burnt raw and blistered from a burning beam. He does not take the lantern back. In the black face of the stone, a lead ball is lodged with a small star of cracks around it. At the foot of the stone a small girl of eight sits on the black ground in a long dress, unhurt, hugging her knees. Far behind, the white wall glows above the flames, archers dark along its top. Sparks and burning chaff whirl large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕选两盏马灯上了碑顶、墙上一箭钉进东面、营里一枪穿过博扬左小臂嵌进西面，源稿第1361到1362行。镜头放在碑西面，安诺倒在碑东脚下那一处叫碑挡住了，箭在东面也看不见。妲娜八岁，坐在碑脚下没有伤。

nodes.name: 捻灰
who: the fire-horn contract judge with ash-white fingertips
nodes.light: flat grey light of an overcast autumn morning, and one small brief orange flame at a charred post
nodes.camera: low among the ash, close behind a charred post, the judge kneeling in the middle; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an overcast autumn morning among the burnt-out wheat sheds west of a boundary stone. The sheds are gone: only rows of charred posts stand in a floor of black ash and grey cinders, and a few blackened beams lie where roofs fell. In the middle of the picture, kneeling in the ash in full profile facing right, is the fire-horn contract judge with ash-white fingertips: a tall, slender woman who looks under thirty, charcoal-grey skin, a pair of dark red horns sweeping back from the brow with blackened tips, black hair in one tight braid down her back, amber eyes, a long black coat belted close with its hem tucked up, leather knee pads, a pouch of small ash bags at her waist; on a leather cord at her chest hang the two halves of a sawn iron ring, their cut edges blackened. Her right hand holds an open book of drawn fires; her left hand is held flat, palm down, just above the ash, its fingertips ash-white. Under her hand the ash has lifted from the ground by itself and gathered into a short, flickering flame that stands at the foot of a charred corner post, burning nothing. Her face is patient and exact, her eyes on the flame. Around her in the ash lie a few curved shards of broken clay pots. Far behind her, across a strip of black field, the waist-high boundary stone shows its black face, and beyond it the long white wall. At the edge of the burnt ground a tall young farmer with a bandaged left forearm stands and watches. Fine ash drifts large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕选哈迪雅在麦棚的灰里倒着找、灰末聚起一朵火苗停在棚角，源稿第1374行。两张赏格、碑匠刨出火绳筒那几拍没有画。站在远处的是博扬。

nodes.name: 黑地新绿
nodes.light: bright clear spring morning light, fresh green shining against black ash, a thin line of smoke far off
nodes.camera: low along a furrow at the height of the young shoots, the farmer walking toward the left; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a bright spring morning in a field west of a long white wall, half a year after a fire. The ground here is still black with ash, but out of it, in long straight rows, fresh green wheat shoots have just broken through, so vivid against the black that they almost glow. In the near foreground, walking along a furrow in full profile facing left, is the tall black-haired contract farmer: long-boned and broad-shouldered, stiff short black hair with a blue sheen, deep blue eyes, a coarse undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a cloth seed bag slung across his chest. Both his palms are covered with shiny healed scar, and on his left forearm there is a round scar on each side where a lead ball went through. His right hand trails over the tips of the shoots; his left hand hangs loose. His back is very straight and his face is calm, almost smiling. A few steps behind him, also in profile, follows a small girl of nine in a plain long-sleeved dress, copying his steps. In the middle distance stands the waist-high boundary stone, its black face toward us with a lead ball still lodged in it; two steps to the south of it stands a new white stele, ringed all round with old blackened sickles planted upright in the earth. Beyond the stone, on the wall side, a thin line of slow fire creeps across last year's stubble and stops at the stone. The white wall runs across the far background. Grains of ash and drops of dew drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束选902年开春博扬把祖父那一袋种撒进灰里、第三天出了苗、妲娜跟着他进垄，源稿第1387行，烧麦那一块碑萌芽月立起来，第1384行，维布克那一边慢慢烧麦茬放在远处。

nodes.name: 拳印
nodes.light: deep night; the only light is a hard red glow leaking from between a man's clenched fingers and through the cloth on his back, spilling out through the gaps of a plank shed
nodes.camera: low, just inside the open front of the shed, at table height, looking at the seated man; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: late at night in autumn, at the wooden gate of a small walled town in the southern mountains of the west. Beside the gate leans a cobbler's shed of rough planks, its front open. Inside, filling the picture, the huge grey-green half-orc cobbler sits facing us at his work table: about two metres tall, immensely heavy and broad-backed, grey-green skin, short messy dark brown hair going grey at the temples, a short stubble beard, calm brown eyes now fixed on nothing. He wears a coarse undyed coat with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, his scarred forearms bare. Both his hands lie on the table side by side, clenched into fists, and have been clenched all night; the cloth bands wrapped round them have charred to black and are flaking away; hard red light leaks from between his fingers, and the wood under his fists is scorched black in the shape of two fists. Under his coat, in the middle of his back, something glows red through the cloth. Sweat runs down his temples; his jaw is locked; he does not move. The red light shines out through the gaps between the planks and turns the boot soles hung up to dry outside the colour of blood. In the corner, on a low stool, a thin half-orc boy of fifteen sleeps against the wall, a pair of patched boots on his feet, a faint red glow under the cloth on his own back. Through the open front behind us lies the dark town gate. Flakes of charred cloth and fine sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕选上旬三日那一夜门印烫起来、他攥着拳坐了一夜、桌上烙出两个拳印，源稿第1630行。盖格十五岁，睡着，脚上是格拉德替他穿上的那双靴子。

nodes.name: 皮卷
nodes.light: warm low firelight from a hearth on the left, and a fading red glow under the cloth on the half-orc's back
nodes.camera: low on the stone floor among the unrolled hide scrolls, the two seated figures beyond; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an autumn evening inside a stone house in a narrow valley village; the walls are rough grey stone and a small hearth fire burns on the left. Across the stone floor in the near foreground, long rolls of tanned hide have been unrolled one after another, covered with dense rows of small marks burnt into the leather with red-hot bone needles. On the left, in full profile facing right, an old half-orc woman sits on a low stool: grey-brown skin, white hair in two long thin braids, small lower tusks, a shawl of undyed wool; her right hand rests on an open scroll across her knees, her left hand is lifted, her eyes half shut, her mouth open on a long chanting note. On the right, in full profile facing left toward her, sits the huge grey-green half-orc on a stone stool: about two metres tall, immensely heavy, short dark brown hair grey at the temples, a short stubble beard, a coarse undyed coat with the sleeves rolled, his scarred forearms bare, both fists bound in charred cloth bands. Behind his stool a pale groove scraped across the floor shows where it skidded when he lunged; now, as she chants, his shoulders are sinking, his feet are planting themselves flat on the stone, and the red glow under the cloth on his back is fading. His fists rest on his knees, and his calm brown eyes are on the scroll. In the low doorway behind them stands a thin barefoot half-orc boy holding a coiled iron chain, watching. Hearth smoke and floating ash drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕选嘉尔娜的祖母念谱系、他的脚踩住地、肩膀落下去，源稿第1643行。祖母源稿没写样子，照半兽人老妇人写。焦门营门口挨打、跟齐亚德说话那几拍没有画。

nodes.name: 接锤
nodes.light: the first grey-gold light of dawn beyond the gate, the dull red glow pulsing along the ram's chains and in the broken brand on the half-orc's back
nodes.camera: low on the hilltop behind the gate, beside an empty black stone chair, looking back through the archway at the half-orc's back and the ram; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn on the top of a hill of knee-deep grey ash in the western mountains. A city gate stands alone on the hilltop: a massive stone gate-tower dragged here long ago, its dark archway open through the middle of the picture. We stand behind it on the hilltop, beside a huge empty chair of black stone at the left edge of the frame, and look back through the archway. In the archway, seen directly from behind and filling it, stands the huge grey-green half-orc: about two metres tall, immensely broad-backed, grey-green skin, short dark brown hair grey at the temples, his coat torn open across the back. Fourteen small black iron shards are grown into the skin of his shoulders and back; one of them, in the middle of his back, has just been crushed by his own hand into a raw pit, red light still glowing in its cracks, blood running down from it. His feet stand in two worn footprints in the stone floor of the archway. His right arm is thrust straight forward, and on his right fist rests the whole weight of an enormous iron-banded battering ram, too thick for a man to put his arms around, which has swung down on chains from a black gate frame outside and stopped dead at the mouth of the arch. Dull red light runs along its chains; one chain has snapped. Beyond the ram, a wave of grey ash has been flung up in front of the gate, and through it the dawn shows, with a crowd of fire-horn men whose horns burn like torches. Toward us, out of the archway past his legs, exactly six children are running down the back of the hill, unhurt, in long homespun tunics: four half-orc children with small lower tusks and two fire-horn children with small burning horns. They run with frightened, desperate faces, mouths open gasping for breath, cheeks streaked with ash; none of them smiles. The last and smallest, the smallest half-orc girl, runs at the back of them with her face set and fierce, the bitten-through end of a rope still dangling from her small fist. Grey ash and sparks blow large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕选锤已经接在他拳上、嘉尔娜咬断绳子、六个孩子从他身后跑下坡那一下，源稿第1663到1665行，不画孩子跪在门洞里等锤。八岁的嘉尔娜用了立绘目录里的 s6b_jarna_child。血只在格拉德背上，孩子都没伤。 主会话：试画头一稿孩子们一个个在笑、画了七个、最小的那个回头，改成六个、惊慌、最小的那个攥着咬断的绳头往前跑（不回头）。

nodes.name: 台上六人
nodes.light: pale clear spring daylight, cold ash blowing like snow, the dark red-gold of a copper stele
nodes.camera: low at the foot of the stone platform, just behind the half-orc's back, looking up at the stele and the two carvers; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a spring day on the top of a hill of cold grey ash in the western mountains; the wind lifts the ash and blows it across the hill like snow. On the hilltop stands a square stone platform with four empty post-holes at its corners, and on it a stele of dark red-gold mountain copper. On its back face, which we see, five short rows of carved marks have just been cut, and one place below them is still empty. On the platform, in full profile facing right toward the stele, stands the tall moss-braided half-orc woman: about twenty-six, very tall and broad-shouldered, grey-brown skin, unruly moss-green hair in two thick braids, orange-yellow eyes, two small lower tusks, one with a chipped corner, a frayed rope end tied on her left wrist; a knee-length dark moss-green wool coat over a linen tunic, a mallet and chisel at her belt. Her right hand rests on the shoulder of a young fire-horn man beside her, who stands in full profile facing the empty place with a chisel in his left hand and a mallet in his right, not yet striking: slender, dark red hair, horns ringed with black obsidian at the roots, the tips scorched black. At the foot of the platform, in the near foreground and seen directly from behind, stands the huge grey-green half-orc, his greying head bowed a little, both fists in charred cloth bands at his sides; he has not climbed up. Behind the stele stand an empty chair of black stone and an old black gate frame with one broken chain hanging from it, a huge iron-banded ram half buried in the ash at its foot. Far down the slope, a young fire-horn woman waits alone. Ash drifts large and out of focus across the near corners like snow.
nodes.note: 收束选944年开春那六个孩子回灰岗自己刻名字、尤素拿着凿子站了很久、嘉尔娜说你也在台上，源稿第1682行和第4308行。嘉尔娜那时二十六岁，用 s6b_jarna 正装那一套。坡下等着的是苏海拉，格拉德站在台基底下没上去。尤素没有立绘，照焦门氏角冠家的样子写。

nodes.name: 银剑旗
who: the black-haired tiefling with the bleached sleeve
nodes.light: deep summer night: the cold white glow of the wall and its spell circles, a long row of glowing white spears of light, the orange of countless campfires on the slope beyond
nodes.camera: low in the wheat just behind the tiefling, looking past her toward the wall; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a summer night in a field of ripening wheat west of a long white wall. We look east from the wheat toward the wall, which runs across the whole picture and away to the horizon on both sides, glowing faintly by itself. Along its parapets shine rows of circular spell patterns, and out of them a long row of white spears made of light stands straight out over the field, level, their points aimed west toward us. Behind the wall rises a long slope, and the whole slope is covered with campfires, thousands of small orange lights, under tall banners that hang black, each bearing a silver sword. In the near foreground, beside a waist-high boundary stone whose black face is toward us, stands the black-haired tiefling with the bleached sleeve, seen directly from behind: slim and wiry, black hair cut at the chin, a pair of short horns curling forward from her temples with their roots bound in strips of grey cloth; a grey army coat with the sleeves rolled to the elbow; on her back a single-shot long gun with its stock wrapped in grey cloth; tied twice round her left upper arm, an old sleeve bleached almost white and marked with seven small grey marks. Her right hand rests on the top of the boundary stone; her left hand hangs at her side. She stands quite still, looking up at the banners. In the wheat on either side of her, a few young soldiers in grey coats crouch and watch the wall. Wheat ears and a few sparks carried on the warm wind drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕选茉妲头一夜走到界碑底下看墙、认出缓坡上按剑会那几面黑底银剑的旗，源稿第1935行，墙上术式兵团伸出来的光矛照第1930行。她背上的单发火药枪是黑耀那一边930年的东西。

nodes.name: 四十三万
who: the young knight with the kite feather
nodes.light: clear white daylight pouring through tall windows behind the head of the table, gold glinting on rich clothes
nodes.camera: low at the near end of the long table, looking down its whole length at the woman at its head; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a summer day in a long, high hall of white stone used for receiving envoys, in a palace above a great city. A very long table runs from the near foreground straight away from us down the middle of the picture. On both sides sit envoys of many kingdoms and duchies in rich coats and chains of office, seen in full profile, turned toward the head of the table. At its far end, facing us, sits the copper-haired empress: a tall woman who looks twenty-seven or twenty-eight, old-copper gold-brown hair to her shoulders tied low at the nape, a few front locks singed pale, pale gold eyes, a thin white scar at the tail of her left eyebrow, an old burn scar on the back of her right hand. She wears a white-gold and old-copper military dress coat over a shirt of fine mountain-copper mail, a cloak at her shoulders, and at her old leather belt a plain straight sword with a hilt wrapped in rough hemp cord. Her left hand lies flat on the table; the forefinger of her right hand rests on the tabletop where it has been tapping out a count, and has stopped. Her eyes are on a richly dressed duke who stands halfway down the left side of the table in full profile, his mouth open on an answer that does not come. In the last chair at the near end sits a priest in grey, silent. Along the back wall near us stands a row of attendants; among them, in full profile, the young knight with the kite feather: nineteen, tall and thin, sandy-gold hair cut very short, pale gold eyes, a long white wool coat with a kite feather embroidered at the collar, white gloves, his face troubled. Behind the empress, tall windows pour in white daylight. Dust motes drift large and out of focus in the window light across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕选东边那一半，冠台西边长厅里她点完四十三万、问台上几个孩子、银鹿公爵答不上来，源稿第1944到1945行。西边法碑底下认袖子那一半没有画。她的立绘是661年南线军官那一套，text 里照930年的军礼服写。

nodes.name: 烛缝
who: the black-haired tiefling with the bleached sleeve
the young knight with the kite feather
nodes.light: low red-gold sunset light streaming into the gateway from behind us, a single white candle flame at the centre, cool shadow deep inside the arch
nodes.camera: at the western mouth of the gateway, low, looking straight east down the length of the arch; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunset at harvest time, in the long arched gateway through a white wall-town on a great wall. We stand at its western mouth and look straight down the length of the arch toward the town; the setting sun behind us shines straight in and lights the stone floor all the way through. At the far, town-side end, nine small stone tablets stand side by side against the walls. In the middle of the floor, in a seam between the paving stones, a single white candle burns upright. Nearest to us, just inside the western mouth and facing us, stands the black-haired tiefling with the bleached sleeve: slim and wiry, black hair cut at the chin, short horns curling forward with grey cloth at their roots, amber eyes with slit pupils, a buttoned grey army coat with faint red lines at the seams, an old bleached sleeve tied round her left upper arm; her back is to the gateway and her face to her own people outside; her right hand is raised flat, palm down, telling them to lower their guns; her left hand hangs at her side. Beside her stands a tall, pale border officer of the bone folk with a round bone shield on her left arm. Behind them, in the middle of the gateway beside the candle and facing us, stands the grey-cropped gate-keeper: broad-backed, feet planted apart, grey hair cropped short, a notch missing from the top of his left ear, small pale cornflower-blue eyes, a grey-brown surcoat over old chain mail, a big copper key at his neck; both hands hang at his sides. Beside the candle stand an eight-year-old girl and a lean horned man holding her hand. At the far eastern mouth, the young knight with the kite feather sits on a grey horse turned crosswise across the arch, seen directly from behind, a white round shield on his left arm turned toward the town, a grey-white kite feather in the crest of his open helm. Beyond him, in the town street, a troop of mounted knights in polished plate sits halted, their leader's hand resting on a slender spell-tube at his hip. Dust and chaff glitter large and out of focus in the low sunlight across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕选门洞里三个人谁也没看谁的那一刻，文策尔站在当中朝西、吕迪格的马横在朝城里那一头、茉妲背对门洞叫自己的人放下枪，源稿第1971到1977行。赫尔弗里德这时已经把铳收了，写成手搭在腰上的施法铳管上。雅思敏八岁，站在白烛边上没有伤。

nodes.name: 碑下一冬
who: the witch-queen in the dark red coat
nodes.light: a still winter night: the cold white glow of the wall and of the stone's white face, the orange of campfires beyond the wall, snow catching both
nodes.camera: low, looking north along the wall and the boundary stone, the seated woman in full profile in the foreground; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a winter night at the foot of a long white wall that glows faintly by itself; snow lies over the bare fields. The wall rises along the right side of the picture and runs away into the distance; along its parapets, rows of archers stand with their bows only half drawn, the strings slack, and above the wall the sky is lit orange by campfires without number. In the foreground, one arrow-shot out from the wall, stands a waist-high boundary stone: its face toward the wall white and glowing, its face toward the west black obsidian. At the foot of the black face, on a low flat stone, sits the witch-queen in the dark red coat, in full profile facing right toward the stone and the wall: a slender woman who looks twenty-five or twenty-six, long ash-silver hair darker grey toward the tips, loosely gathered at the back with a dark red mountain-copper ornament, a few strands at her face; cold pale skin, a tiny ruby-red mark at one temple, gold eyes glowing faintly in the dark. A long dark red coat cut like a uniform hangs from her left shoulder only, over a long black dress, a dark-gold band of mountain copper at her waist; a long black glove covers her right arm to above the elbow. Her gloved right hand rests on her knee; her left hand lies open in her lap. Snow has settled on her shoulders and in her hair, and she has not brushed it off. Her face is calm and patient. Far off on the left, across the snowy fields to the west, the dark ranks of a standing army wait beside a few low fires, not moving. Snowflakes drift large and out of focus across the near corners, lit white and orange.
nodes.note: 收束选她在刀桥段城底下头一块界碑黑的那一面底下坐了一冬、墙上的弓弦拉到一半就松了，源稿第1957行、第1988行。坐在一块平石上是我补的，源稿只写坐下来。她立国以后的衣着照人物条第3821行写。

nodes.name: 冷火
nodes.light: the whole underground city glowing a dull red like embers, and a long spiral of small cold blue-white lamps climbing through it
nodes.camera: low on a stone street at the bottom of the city, beside the old woman's doorstep, looking up at the spiral stair; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night, deep under a mountain, in the lowest ring of a dwarf city built inside a dead volcano: a vast round cavern of stone houses climbing in tiers around a great furnace at its centre. Every lamp in the city has turned a dull red, and the great furnace in the background glows orange and breathes with difficulty. Up through the tiers climbs a long spiral stair, and on it some twelve hundred dwarves are going up in a single line, carrying bundles, tools, children and the old on their backs; among them, every so often, a lamp of cold flameless blue-white light lights the step beneath their feet, so that a thin spiral of blue climbs through the red city toward the darkness above. In the near foreground, on her doorstep, sits the old white-bearded dwarf matriarch, facing us: small and grown thin with age but square-shouldered, a long white beard braided into plaits threaded with dozens of fire-copper rings, white hair drawn back tight, washed-out blue eyes, a loose old wool robe and a thick shawl, soft felt shoes; both her scarred hands hold a small cup in her lap. Her face is calm and stubborn; she is not going. Along the street behind her, other very old dwarves sit on their own doorsteps, facing the furnace. On the lowest step of the stair, in full profile facing her, stands the small silver-haired well-listener: a slight dwarf woman who looks about twenty, silver-white hair cut at the ears and tied with a bit of well rope, big ice-blue eyes, a grey film of dust on her face, a short dark leather coat; her right hand holds up a flameless blue lamp, her left hand is held out toward the old woman, open. Red cinders and blue glints drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕选中旬六日夜里一千二百来口照着深井的冷火往上走、一百一十七个老人跟着兰维格坐在自家门口，源稿第2235行。托芙朝她伸手是我补的动作。王城的地这一夜还没裂，没写裂缝。

nodes.name: 一铲火
nodes.light: every lamp in the room a dull sick red, and one clean yellow arc of fire flying across from a bread oven
nodes.camera: low on the floor of the furnace room, between the bread oven and the cold furnace core, the arc of fire passing overhead; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night in the furnace room of a wall-town on a great wall. Its stone walls are cut from floor to ceiling with old furnace diagrams in carved marks, and a rack of old forging hammers hangs on one wall. Every lamp in the room has turned a dull, sick red. On the right rises a huge black furnace core, cold and dead for nine hundred years, its iron mouth gaping open. On the left, a small brick bread oven still burns with an ordinary clean yellow fire, the only yellow light in the room. Between them, in full profile facing right, the old flour-browed dwarf baker is caught in the middle of a throw: short and stocky, a round face with a big nose red at the tip, small bright amber eyes, flour on her brows, two thick braids once ginger and now mostly white coiled on her head under a tied cloth, an oilcloth apron tied tight, soot on her face, a knotted cord on one wrist. Both her hands swing a long wooden baking peel forward, the left hand low on the shaft and the right hand high, and from its blade a whole shovelful of yellow fire is flying through the air in an arc toward the black mouth of the cold furnace. Her mouth is open, shouting. On the far right, beside the cold furnace, stands the sandy-haired cannon-keeper in full profile facing left toward her: a short, broad dwarf who looks about thirty, sandy-blond hair cut short, a short-trimmed sandy beard with no rings in it, amber-grey eyes wide, an old scorched leather coat, a ring of thirty-two iron keys at his waist; his right hand grips the long iron lever of the furnace's air gate, ready to pull it; his left hand is empty. Glowing embers stream from the arc of fire large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕选红炉段城那一头，约伦没等弗罗德回话，自己把那一铲火扔进冷了九百年的炉心，源稿第2246到2249行。炉城那一头的炉台和三十二座化开重铸那几拍没有画。

nodes.name: 末息
nodes.light: only the faint dull red of a dying furnace from below, lighting the faces from beneath; deep darkness above
nodes.camera: low at the very rim of the furnace mouth, looking up at the two dwarves standing over it; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the hour before dawn, at the rim of a great royal furnace deep under a mountain; the city around it has sunk into the earth and the stone platform round the furnace tilts. In the near foreground, the furnace mouth is a wide round pit in which only a thin layer of dull red remains, like overburnt charcoal, swelling and shrinking faintly; its light comes up from below. Standing at the rim beyond it, facing us, is the broad dwarf forge-master: short, about 140 cm, enormously broad, chest and back as thick as an anvil; a great brown beard in two thick plaits threaded with fire-copper rings, thick wavy brown hair under a plain iron headband, steady amber-grey eyes; a burnt leather apron tied over a thick leather jerkin, soot on his face. His right arm hangs at his side; his left arm is stretched out sideways, the hand open and waiting, and the palm of that hand is burnt through, raw and bleeding. His face is calm and decided. Beside him on our right, in full profile facing him, stands the small silver-haired well-listener: a slight dwarf woman, silver-white hair cut at the ears and tied with well rope, big ice-blue eyes, grey well-dust on her face, a buttoned leather coat, a bundle of wooden props on her back. With her right hand she holds out a small prop-splitting hatchet to him, handle first; her left hand is pressed to her chest. Her eyes are on his face. Behind them in the dark, dozens of dwarves strain at great bellows, and two of them carry between them a heavy pot of glowing molten copper ore. Faint red cinders drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕选布洛姆加把烫穿了的左手伸给托芙要斧子、托芙递过去的那一下，源稿第2264行，不画砍下胳膊（不写断肢）。抬过来的那一锅山铜矿浆照第2265行放在后头。

nodes.name: 第十九座
nodes.light: clear pale gold autumn morning sun from behind, the new bronze of the cannon bases warm, long shadows on the wall-walk
nodes.camera: low on the wall-walk beside the nineteenth cannon base, close on the kneeling dwarf; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a clear autumn morning on the top of a great white wall. Along the wall-walk, a bow-shot apart, stands a row of mountain-copper fire cannons on heavy round bases, their bronze freshly cast and smooth, the row running away into the distance. In the near middle of the picture is one of these bases, larger than a man; near its foot a hairline crack runs across the metal. Kneeling at it, in full profile facing right, is the broad dwarf forge-master: short and enormously broad, a great brown beard in two thick plaits threaded with fire-copper rings, brown hair under a plain iron headband, amber-grey eyes; a heavy patched leather apron over a thick wool shirt. His right sleeve hangs empty and is pinned up, and the shoulder above it is bound in clean cloth. His left hand lies flat on the base, two of its fingers stiff and crooked, the fingertips resting on the hairline crack. His head is bent close, as if listening to the metal. A step behind him, in full profile facing the same way, stands the sandy-haired cannon-keeper: a short, broad dwarf who looks about thirty, sandy-blond hair cut short, a short-trimmed sandy beard with no rings, amber-grey eyes like the older dwarf's, an old leather guard coat scorched at the cuffs, a ring of thirty-two iron keys at his waist; his hands hang at his sides and he says nothing. Below the wall to the west lie a field of wheat stubble, a line of boundary stones and, beyond them, the roofs of a small village. Fine golden dust drifts large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束选坠叶月上旬布洛姆加到红炉段城拿左手摸到第十九座底下那一道缝、弗罗德站在他身后，源稿第2282行。右袖空着、肩上缠布，不画伤口。两根指节弯不灵照第2269行。

nodes.name: 数结谣
nodes.light: grey-white fog glowing at the top of a crack, dim cold light reaching down into the dark between rock walls
nodes.camera: deep inside the crack, looking straight up the rock walls toward the strip of foggy sky; strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a summer evening, deep inside a narrow crack that has opened in a wheat field. We look straight up between two rough walls of rock; far above, the crack's mouth is a strip of glowing grey-white fog. A rope hangs down the middle of the picture, tied with knots an arm's length apart. On it, halfway down, hangs the barefoot well-digger, facing us: not tall, broad-shouldered and long-armed, wheat-straw hair cropped very short, an oilcloth cap pushed back, a round face with a small scar across the nose, olive-green eyes, a grey wool coat with mended cuffs, the rope tied round his waist, nothing tied to its end; his bare feet are braced against the rock wall. His left hand grips the rope above his head; his right hand has just closed around the small hand of a child below him. The child is the little mist-haired boy: eight years old, curly mist-blue hair, two small bumps at his temples where horns are breaking through, a long-sleeved homespun tunic and a fleece vest; he crouches on a narrow ledge of rock, unhurt, reaching up with his right hand, his left hand clutching a small copper goat bell. Further down, on another ledge in the dark, a black goat looks up. At the very top, leaning over the edge in the fog, facing us, is the mist-haired tiefling girl: a sturdy young woman, mist-blue hair in a coiled braid beaded with fog, small slate-grey horns sweeping back, the left tip chipped, pale yellow eyes glowing in the fog, a faded homespun dress; both her hands grip the rope at its very front, and behind her three soldiers in grey coats haul on it. Grit and drops of fog fall large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕选蝉鸣月中旬傍晚本特拴着绳下缝、唱到第十一句摸到阿托的手、卡雅攥在绳的最前头，源稿第2531行。阿托八岁，只画被拉住的那一下，用了立绘目录里的 s6b_ato。本特立绘那一套绳头拴着羊铃，那是往后的事，text 里写明绳头空着。

nodes.name: 铜铃
nodes.light: the cold blue-white of the first snow at dawn, with a faint warm gold at the eastern sky behind the wall
nodes.camera: low on the snow west of the boundary stone, close on the bell at the foot of its black face, the crouching man beside it; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn after the first snow of winter, in a field west of a long white wall. A thin layer of snow covers everything. The field is strange: long rows of wheat that nobody cut still stand in it, dry and pale, their ears bowed under the snow, and between them lines of wooden stakes and ropes mark narrow dark cracks in the ground. In the near foreground stands a waist-high boundary stone with its black obsidian face toward us, snow along its top. At the foot of the black face, on the snow, lies a small copper goat bell; its broken cord has been tied together again with a small, unfamiliar knot. Crouching beside it, in full profile facing left, is the barefoot well-digger: not tall, broad-shouldered, wheat-straw hair cropped short under an oilcloth cap, a round face with a small scar across the nose, olive-green eyes, a grey wool coat with mended cuffs over a coarse shirt, brown trousers rolled at the ankle, his bare feet in the snow, a coil of knotted rope at his waist with nothing tied to its end. His right hand reaches toward the bell and has stopped just short of it; his left hand rests on his knee. His breath steams. His face is puzzled and gentle. Behind the stone the white wall rises across the picture, glowing faintly, with a water gate in it over a river. A single line of small footprints in the snow comes to the stone and goes away again. Snowflakes drift large and out of focus across the near corners, lit gold by the dawn.
nodes.note: 二幕选幕终，初雪第二天天亮本特在水门底下那一块界碑黑曜石那一面的碑脚下看见那只铜铃、铃绳打着他没见过的结，源稿第2544行。天上那一层光暗下去、缝里有哭声那几拍没有单画。

nodes.name: 折桌
nodes.light: warm yellow lamplight spreading under a low ceiling of fog, the pot steaming, the cold white glow of the wall beyond
nodes.camera: low at the height of the table top, looking north along the line of the boundary stone, the table across the middle; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the last night of the year, in a snowy field at the foot of a long white wall. A small folding table has been set up right beside a waist-high boundary stone, so that two of its legs stand on the white-stone side and two on the black-stone side; we look straight along the line, the white wall glowing on the right and the dark fields on the left. On the table sits a dented pot of steaming wheat porridge and four wooden bowls. A fog from the river has come down to the table's edge, and a young woman is holding it up: the mist-haired tiefling girl sits on the left in full profile facing right, mist-blue hair in a coiled braid, small slate-grey horns sweeping back with the left tip chipped, pale yellow eyes glowing, a wool vest over a homespun dress; she hums with her lips closed, her left hand raised palm up, and the fog has lifted above their heads into a soft ceiling under which the lamplight spreads warm and gold. A small boy with mist-blue curls sleeps leaning against her right side. On the right, in full profile facing left, sits the barefoot well-digger, wheat-straw hair under an oilcloth cap, a grey wool coat, his bare feet in the snow, holding out a bowl across the table with both hands. Behind the table, facing us, stands the round halfling healer: small and round, red cheeks, curly grey-white hair, smiling, his hazel eyes narrowed to happy arcs, a freshly washed grey-white robe and a white stole; his right hand ladles porridge into the bowl, his left hand holds the pot's handle. On the ceiling of fog above them, the shadows of their reaching arms meet. On a rock beyond the stone, a night-wing in a dark coat perches and watches. Snowflakes and drops of mist drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕选归寂月末日四个人隔着界碑吃一锅两边的麦、卡雅把雾托过头顶、手臂的影子在头顶接到一处，源稿第2553到2555行。石头上那个夜翼是边官泽菲，没有立绘。

nodes.name: 岁末一声
nodes.light: the grey-blue of the last hour before dawn, the cold white glow of the long wall, a few warm lamps
nodes.camera: high above the field, looking almost straight down on the tiny table by the boundary stone, the wall across the top of the picture; slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the last hour before dawn on the last night of the year, seen from high above a wide snowy basin. Across the top of the picture runs a long white wall that glows faintly by itself, with a water gate in it where three rivers meet; tiny watchers line its parapets. Below the wall lies the snow-covered field, and across it, in a long line parallel to the wall, small boundary stones stand at regular intervals. All over the field, dark cracks run through the snow, dozens of them, and every one of them runs toward the water gate in the wall, converging there. In the middle of the picture, very small, beside one boundary stone, stands a tiny folding table with a steaming pot on it and four small figures around it: a round little man in a pale robe, a broad young man in a grey coat, a young woman in a homespun dress and a small child asleep against her. At this very instant a deep sound has come up from under the ground: the snow has leapt up off the earth all around them in a wide ring; the porridge in the pot has broken into rings; the three grown figures are looking down at their feet, and the child, waking, clings to the young woman. On the wall, the tiny watchers have all turned their heads. Far off on the western side, a night-wing perched on a rock has half opened its wings. A faint grey light has just begun at the eastern edge of the sky beyond the wall. Loose snow hangs in the air large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束停在那一声，源稿第2557行和第2560行。从高处俯看，人都是远处的小人，没写 who。只画地底下响了一声、雪跳起来那一下，缝不画到底，地底下是什么不画。

nodes.name: 碑坯
nodes.light: white-orange furnace glare from the forge mouth on the left, a hard shaft of frost-white light falling from the roof in the middle, cold blue snow-dark at the open street door on the right
nodes.camera: low, close to the stone floor among the risen slabs, looking across the workshop toward the forge mouth, a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an early-winter night in the lower town of a walled city, inside a stone-carver's workshop; outside the open street door the first snow is falling. The brick forge mouth fills the left third of the picture, cut off by the left edge and roaring white-orange. In its mouth, standing inside the flames without burning, is a boy who looks fourteen or fifteen: short light-brown hair under a small round brimless cap, a plain dark jacket buttoned to the throat with a ring of scorch at each cuff, facing us, his right hand raised, his left hand empty at his side, his face pale and unhappy. Four fire-beasts have come out of the forge: hound-sized skeletons with no hide, their bones lit from inside by orange flame with a white core. Beside the forge an iron anvil sags and runs to the floor like wax. In the middle of the picture a straight shaft of frost-white light has just come down through a hole in the roof and pinned one beast to the floor, rime spreading from it across the flagstones. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, kneels the apprentice stonemason, apricot-red hair under a grey headscarf, pale stone dust on her forearms, in full profile facing left: her right palm heel slammed flat on the floor, her left hand braced on her knee, jaw set. In front of her three blank grey stone slabs have just risen out of the floor, shielding a young woman crouched behind them in a long grey wool dress to the ankles, flour on her sleeves, light brown hair under a plain kerchief, both hands pressed to the nearest slab. Between the slabs and the forge stands the young northern spearman, deep teal hair with a short braid, ice-blue eyes, in full profile facing left, both hands on his spear held low across his body, breathing out a long plume of white frost; two beasts lie at his feet as frost-covered skeletons, their flame gone out. Far back by the street door, small, a porcelain-pale woman with grey-brown curls and a white ruffled headdress sits on a low floating machine, her right hand raised, a ring of twelve small square panes of light around her, seven of them lit, a clockwork hound at her feet. Sparks and snowflakes cross the near corners large and out of focus.
nodes.note: 一幕第五拍（源稿“他一抬手，炉口涌出四只烬兽”那一条），取光亮到第七格、凝霜的光钉穿屋顶那一下，碑坯、冻住的两只、孩子退回火里同时在。伊诺克看着十四五，只让他站在火里抬手，不受伤。默娜没有立绘，长相照筛面的姑娘补的，要对一下源稿第4679行。玛丽贝尔没有键，照开局那一拍写的样子。

nodes.name: 冷灯
who: the slender youth with ash-violet hair and a gold monocle
nodes.light: almost no light: a single grey-blue bead left in the lamp on the table, and the cold grey-blue of snow through the open door at the back, against deep blue-black shadow everywhere else
nodes.camera: level with the tabletop, square across the table between the two seated figures, the spearman's bench in the near left, a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a winter night near the end of the year, in a half-empty soldiers' barracks built against the foot of a long white stone wall; snow lies deep outside. The room is long and low, with plank benches, an iron stove and one oil lamp on a plank table in the middle. Every light in the room has just gone dark at once: the lamp flame has shrunk to a small grey-blue bead, the coals in the stove have gone grey, and no one has touched them. At the table two people sit face to face, both in full profile. On the left sits a young woman in a long grey wool dress buttoned to the throat, flour still in the seams of her sleeves, light brown hair under a plain kerchief; both hands lie flat on the table, her face tired and steady, her mouth just closed. Across from her on the right sits the slender youth with ash-violet hair, who looks fifteen or sixteen: messy ash-violet hair tied loosely at the nape with a faded strip of old cloth, amber-gold eyes, long slender pointed ears like an elf's showing through his hair, a single round gold-rimmed monocle on a thin gold chain over his right eye only, the eye toward us, his other eye bare and no spectacles, a plain dark travelling coat; his left hand lies open on the table toward her, his right hand rests on his knee, his face gentle and quiet, his lips parted as he speaks to her. In the near left, large and partly cut off by the frame, the young northern spearman with deep teal hair sits slumped on a bench, his spear across his knees, both hands loose on the shaft, the frost on its head gone dull, only a faint thread of white breath at his lips. Beside him the apprentice stonemason with apricot-red hair under a grey headscarf has sunk down to sit on the floor, her left hand braced on the boards, her right hand on her knee, her eyes on the young man. In the dark far right corner the porcelain-pale clockwork woman sits upright against the wall, facing us: soft ash-grey-brown hair in loose curls cut to the chin, short straight blunt bangs and two long soft locks at the front, clear crystal-blue eyes, a white ruffled headdress with long red cords hanging from it, eyes open on the young man, the twelve small panes of light around her all dark.
