Through the open door at the back, the huge iron leg of a four-legged machine stands in the snow, the crystal prisms on its back dark. Fine snow-dust drifts large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第五、六拍（源稿“归寂月下旬……夜里门开了”起两条），取斐里安在默娜对面坐下、正说她姐姐背她过河那一句的时候，一屋子的火已经暗了。没画水站那一仗，四幅里留一幅静的。斐里安是传奇没有键，照这一拍写的样子。

nodes.name: 三步内
nodes.light: hot orange with white cores from the leaping fire-beasts in the foreground and a dull red glow from inside the copper furnace cores, against the deep blue-black dark of the vault
nodes.camera: low among the leaping fire-beasts, just behind them, looking up at the woman who faces them, the furnace cores towering at both edges, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the last night of the year, in a vaulted hall under the half-collapsed arch of a ruined city's south gate, old rooms knocked through into one. Several colossal furnace cores stand in a ring, each as big as a room, round shells of dull mountain copper engraved with rows of old seat-number marks and glowing faintly red from inside; two of them loom at the left and right edges, cut off by the frame. On the floor two doors are painted, each ringed with small oil lamps, and around them several hundred grown men and women kneel in rings, small, most with their eyes closed. In the middle ground, facing us, stands the porcelain-pale clockwork woman, who has just jumped down from a floating machine: soft ash-grey-brown hair in loose curls cut to the chin, short straight blunt bangs and two long soft locks at the front, clear crystal-blue eyes, a white ruffled headdress with long red cords hanging from it, a long grey-and-white dress from neck to the floor, its skirt one closed, full, floor-length layered skirt with no opening or slit at the front, her legs hidden inside it so that only the toes of her two boots peek out under the hem; a large wind-up key is fixed in her lower back and juts straight out behind her waist, its gilded filigree bow inlaid with pale cyan crystal. Her right hand has just closed on the hilt of a clockwork greatsword hanging in the air before her, its blade lined with small gears; her left arm is flung straight out to the side behind her. Her face is calm, her eyes on what is coming. A few steps behind her, small, a young woman in a long grey wool dress and a plain kerchief stands beside a furnace core singing, her right hand tapping time against her skirt, her left hand at her side. In the near foreground, seen from behind and partly cut off by the frame, three fire-beasts are in mid-leap toward the woman, three strides from her: hound-sized skeletons with no hide, their bones lit from inside by orange flame with a white core. Far back between the cores the slender youth with ash-violet hair stands still, facing us and watching her: messy ash-violet hair tied with a faded old cloth strip, long slender pointed ears, a single round gold-rimmed monocle over his right eye only, on the viewer's left, and no spectacles; at the outer painted door a boy of fourteen or fifteen in a small round cap stands with his right hand raised. Hot ash and sparks rush large and out of focus across the corners.

nodes.name: 南门晨
nodes.light: the first low gold of sunrise from the far right, skimming the snow, against the cold blue shadow inside the ruined arch
nodes.camera: low in the snow in front of the gate, a little to the left of the walkers, looking past them toward the arch and the sunrise, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: first light on the first morning after the year's last night, outside the south gate of a city burned to ruin long ago, fresh snow on the rubble. On the left edge, cut off by the frame, stands an old white stone stele, its face covered in rows of weathered carved marks, snow along its top. Beyond it rises the gate arch, half fallen, its dark opening low and narrow under a heap of broken stone, and across that opening a pale grey film like hoar frost has just spread from edge to edge and closed it. Before the arch, on the right, a young woman in a long grey wool dress and a plain kerchief stands in full profile facing left toward the sealed arch: her left hand holds an old sheet of paper creased into many folds, covered in drawn lines and marks, her right palm is laid flat on the frosted stone, her face tired and quiet. Beside her stands a second young woman with the very same face, in the same kind of long grey dress with a shawl over her shoulders, her left hand holding the first one's sleeve. In the near left foreground, walking toward us, the apprentice stonemason with apricot-red hair under a grey headscarf carries a young man on her back, his stone-dusted apprentice's smock buttoned to the throat, his head on her shoulder, eyes closed; her hands are locked under his knees. A step behind her, also walking toward us, the young northern spearman with deep teal hair carries a grey-coated soldier the same way, his spear slung across his back, a puff of white breath at his lips. Behind them some dozens of grown men and women stand in the snow wrapped in blankets, blinking at the light. Far right, small, a tall four-legged machine walks away from us toward a roofless stone house, holding a porcelain-pale woman with grey-brown curls in its forelimbs, a clockwork hound trotting after it. Low on the horizon beyond the ruins the sun is just clearing the snowfield. Glittering snow drifts large and out of focus across the near corners, lit gold.

贡特尔.how: 头一趟过岭的车停在交供台边上，冷灯底下站满了人。他对着灯底下的一个人说那是他妈妈，下了车，站住了，石头合住了他的脚，他说别拽，我站一会儿。天亮以前他没了声音，岭口站那一块山铜板上刻着他的名字。

兰维格.when: 山铜纪934年金穗月中旬七日
兰维格.where: 熔铁炉心的王城，她家门口
兰维格.how: 王城要往下沉，她叫别人上去，自己不上去，说主炉一万年没灭过，她没打算看着它灭，也没打算走。入夜王城往下沉了七百级台阶，她坐在门口朝着王炉，没有回头，跟着她坐在门口的一百一十七个老人都没有上来。

玛丽贝尔.where: 灰雨城南门的门洞底下
玛丽贝尔.how: 伊诺克叫出烬兽扑向唱誓的人，她从阿希奥玛上跳下来，抓住发条大剑的剑柄挡在默娜前头，烬兽烧穿了她。斐里安取走了她胸口那粒炭火，拧下了她背上的钥匙。她倒在炉心中间，把一页折了九百年的纸塞进默娜手里，默娜后来把自己那点火放进了她的胸口，她没有醒。
